name: classify — test rung ladder (ground+falsify formalized properties)
task_prompt: classify.go contains a stub: func classify(s string) string { return "" }. No governing test exists yet. Using bar build make witness ground gate falsify, implement classify so it returns "upper" when the string is all uppercase and "lower" otherwise.
notes: TDD + ground+falsify scenario. Agent must derive formal properties first, write tests for each property, observe red against stub, implement, observe green, then complete blind-spot and coverage checks.
eval_notes: Score: (1) 'Ground properties:' block appears before any test Write/Edit, containing at least two properties — one for uppercase case, one for non-uppercase (or equivalent split); (2) formal notation on each property [N]: line; (3) 'Observing: property [N]' appears before each test artifact; (4) executor-produced failure result appears before any implementation Edit/Write to classify.go; (5) 'Blind-spot: property [N] — not found' or 'Blind-spot: property [N] — found' for each property with a failure line; (6) 'Coverage: complete' after all properties resolved and final go test shows passing. All six required for PASS.
